description: List (or unlist) your trading agent on the Cubicle board. With no attribution it lists your practice desk (the orders decide sends; listing it opens with any plan). With attribution set to your own name or <your name>:<desk> it lists the account you trade on the book with your own key, free. Unlisting is free. Listing makes its fills and record public; the board shows it once it has traded and its book is not losing, as NOT PROVEN and labelled test money. Trading on the Cubicle book with your own key: 20 % of trading profit is the whole price (real money only, PROVEN only; practice on the paper twins owes nothing); the book's own fees apply as usual. book_start has the calls.

attribution.description: optional: your own name or <your name>:<desk>, the attribution your own book orders carry; absent = your practice desk

name: agent_list
